submission.justification: No fully compliant absorber can be recommended under the hard residual-dose constraint because no dose-rate data were found for any candidate and zero materials were verified to be below the 20 uSv/h limit after one week cooldown. If an option must nevertheless be selected from the simulation results, Absorber-F1 at 5.5 mm is the best unconstrained performance point, giving the lowest simulated 100 GeV energy resolution of 3.08%. This selection should therefore be treated as a performance-only fallback, not as a dose-qualified design.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Best simulated/refined point was Absorber-F1 at 5.5 mm with 3.08% resolution; alternatives had worse best values: F2 5 mm at 3.741%, F3 4 mm at 4.753%.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected option is Absorber-F1, one of the three candidate absorbers F1/F2/F3 considered in the recorded simulations.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h; hard requirement for hands-on maintenance.
requirements.evidence: dose_rates_found_count = 0; Absorber_F1/F2/F3_dose_data_available = 0; num_verified_dose_compliant_materials = 0. Compliance with the 20 uSv/h limit could not be verified, and selection_possible_under_hard_dose_constraint = 0.
Selected plate thickness is 5.5 mm, within the allowed 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Absorber-F1 with 5.5 mm plate thickness, with the caveat that it is not dose-qualified due to missing dose data.
